request.description: Request type of this launch configuration

program.description: Absolute path to the Lua file to debug

cwd.description: Working directory for the script. Relative require()/io paths resolve against it. Defaults to the workspace folder.

args.description: Script arguments: available as the global `arg` table (arg[1..]; arg[0] is the script path), and as `...` on Lua 5.2+.

packagePath.description: Entries prepended to Lua's package.path for this launch, e.g. ["${workspaceFolder}/src/?.lua"]. Searched before any global packagePath (settings.json: lsp.lua-debugger.settings.packagePath) and before Lua's defaults.

packageCpath.description: Entries prepended to Lua's package.cpath for this launch (for .dll/.so modules loaded with require). Same precedence rules as packagePath.

luaVersion.description: Which Lua version's lua-dap-server build to launch. Downloaded automatically from GitHub Releases on first use, per platform.

preloadPaths.description: Folders whose .lua files and .dll/.so C modules are automatically loaded into the global table before the debug target runs. .dll/.so files must export a luaopen_<filename> entry point (the standard Lua C-module convention).

debugServerPath.description: Advanced/testing: exact path to a lua-dap-server binary to launch directly, bypassing luaVersion resolution and the download/cache mechanism entirely. Mainly for testing a locally-built binary before it's part of a release.
